message: Hi, my little one Lena is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have a Youth GI class for kids ages 4-7 that would be perfect for Lena. It's a great way for her to get started with Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in a fun, age-appropriate setting. Would you like to book a free trial class for her?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for Lena! What time do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! Can I get your email address? I'll use it to send you the trial confirmation.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
The best phone number to reach me is 860-555-0508.
Got it! Now I just need Lena's full name and date of birth to get her trial booked. What's her full name?
Her full name is Lena Cedar, and she was born on August 12, 2020.

Awesome!
I have a few times available for Lena's trial class this week:

Tuesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 4:45 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 10:00 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM. Thank you!

Perfect! Lena is all set for Tuesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM. You'll get a confirmation email shortly.
Just bring her in comfortable clothes she can move in. We're at 395 County Road 39A. See you then!
